newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rig count up 17 to 858 in latest week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rig count up 17 to 858 in latest week.

text.p: The number of rigs exploring for oil and natural gas in the United States stood at 858 as of December 23, up 17 from the prior week and 96 above the year-ago total of 762, Baker Hughes Inc reported.
The number of rigs drilling on land fell by 12 to 717, while rigs working offshore rose five to 119. The number of rigs active in inland waters remained unchanged at 22.
The biggest change in individual states occurred in Texas, which showed a decrease of 10 and Oklahoma, which showed an increase of 13. Louisiana rose by one.
